PLAN "12-Week Strength Program for Stage III Endometriosis (Phased Around Cycle and Flares)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength safely"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Familiarization" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body C":
        warmup:
          elliptical 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 3m
